Privacy Policy — My Pings

Last updated: August 2026 · Version 0.3.0

My Pings is a Chrome extension by AI4Context. It shows an on-demand list of alerts from sources you choose.

Data we process (on your device)

  • Source URLs, titles, and types you add (RSS, GitHub, ICS, HN, Reddit, Gmail).
  • Ping items fetched on refresh (title, link, dates, read state).
  • UI language, priority keywords, and silence timers per source.
  • GitHub personal access tokens, if you provide one (stored in chrome.storage.local).
  • Gmail OAuth tokens managed by Chrome when you connect Gmail (metadata scope only).

Data fetched on refresh

  • RSS/ICS: feed content from URLs you add.
  • GitHub: public API for events you configure.
  • Hacker News: Algolia HN API (public).
  • Reddit: public JSON for subreddits you choose.
  • Gmail: unread message metadata (from, subject, date) — no email body.

What we do not do

  • We do not read your operating-system notification center.
  • We do not monitor browsing in the background.
  • We do not upload your sources or pings to AI4Context servers.
  • We do not sell your data.

Permissions

  • storage — local sources, pings, and preferences.
  • identity — Gmail OAuth (only if you add Gmail).
  • Optional host access — for origins you add (feeds, Reddit, HN, etc.).
  • https://www.googleapis.com/* — Gmail API when connected.
